obligations.title: Provide progress reports in the form and at the intervals the Customer reasonably requests.
Appoint a delivery lead as primary point of contact.
Appoint a programme sponsor and a project manager with day-to-day decision authority.
Meet at regular intervals to review progress, risks, issues and change requests.
Comply with the Customer's site, security and conduct policies notified in writing.
Maintain technical and organisational measures protecting Customer Data against unauthorised access, loss or disclosure.
Deliver all work in progress and completed Deliverables to the Customer on expiry or termination.
